profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary:
Full Stack Programmer with 7+ years’ experience who specializes in server-side programming, database programming, data structures, and algorithms.

PHP | Python |Java | C# | Sql Server | Mysql | Oracle | RabbitMQ | Linux | API Design | Full Stack | OOP | Data Science |  Devops | Jenkins | Jira | Bitbucket | Continuous Learner | Critical Thinker | Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams | Clearance

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
•   Built high-concurrency services in C# and Python to synchronize more than 1 million identity objects between Azure AD and on-premises systems while maintaining consistency during deployments and service interruptions.

•   Developed Azure-based policy scanners and remediation workflows to monitor least-privilege access across thousands of Key Vaults. The tools automatically removed non-compliant access policies and helped close critical SOX audit findings.

•   Created ARM templates and EV2 CI/CD pipelines that reduced subscription provisioning time from several days to a few hours across three major services.

•   Broke down legacy identity workflows into independently deployable microservices connected through REST APIs, reducing manual processing by 40%.

•   Participated in a five-week primary/secondary on-call rotation and responded to Sev1 and Sev2 incidents. Worked with partner teams to apply hotfixes, roll back changes, and restore service availability.

positions.title: Sr Software engg Applications
positions.description:
•  Developed and scaled a consignment product backend using a stack of PHP, Python, Oracle, MySQL, and   RabbitMQ.

•  Built automated data pipelines to sync enterprise master data from BAAN ERP and ERP LN into the consignment app, eliminating manual updates.
•  Created a custom BI dashboard using PHP, MongoDB, HTML, jQuery, and JavaScript to give stakeholders real-time visual insights into business metrics.

• Migrated legacy Perl and C applications to modern PHP5, improving codebase maintainability and reducing system crashes.

• Designed SOAP and REST APIs to handle secure, low-latency data communication across internal consignment services.

• Applied strict Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles to refactor old code, making the system modular and easier for the team to extend.

• Built a centralized Single Sign-On (SSO) library to secure and unify user authentication across all internal applications.

• Managed code repositories and team workflows using Git and Stash to maintain clean branch management.

• Set up Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, cutting down manual deployment errors and accelerating release cycles.

positions.title: Magneto developer
positions.description:
Magneto e-commerce developer
•	Worked on several products of the company using technologies includes PHP, Mysql, Magento, 
        HTML, CSS, Jquery, and AJAX.
•	Worked on grant management application for the board to process and allocate grants.
•	Designed and maintained MySQL database using the InnoDB engine
•	Developed various custom modules for Magento according to the client’s req.
•	Used PHPUnit to develop test cases for verifying core class features.
•	Followed the MVC (Model-View-Controller) in applications.
•	Worked on SOAP web service development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Application developer, PHP, MySQL, Zeno framework
•	Worked on several products of the company using technologies includes PHP, Mysql, Zend 
        framework, Jquery, and AJAX.
•	Worked on Company’s Product called “Control-Center” using the Zend framework which is being 
        used by the support team to serve clients from the back-end side.
•	Used the Memcached and SQL Optimization technique to speed up the application.
•	Extensively used Object-Oriented Principles in the development of applications.
•	Created REST web services to full fill requirements of API product of the company.
•	Developed custom functions in Mediawiki as per the client’s requirement.

positions.title: Software engg applications
positions.description:
Web development using PHP,mysql vJavaScript, html ,CSS
•	Prepared various accounting reports using PHP and MYSQL
•	Worked on web application development using HTML5. 
•	Research about the implementation of HTML5 and canvas Element in existing websites and submit 
        detailed reports with optimization techniques and also create sample HTML5 canvas to replace 
        current large images.
•	Worked as a mentor on FreedomFlix web-based online learning platform for kids
•	Developed  new Script to add and modify cadre courses in moodle for various entitlement 
        according to the requirement
•	Created XML parser to feed data to flash animation from the content server.
•	Developed digital locker for freedomflix in which users can store threads of their articles, videos 
        and Documents in their profile using PHP, Mysql, HTML, JavaScript, AJAX.

positions.title: Web Analyst
positions.description:
PHP MySQL developer
•	To Plan and develop a web-based system to support medical staff in the emergency department of 
        the hospital.
•	Developed on “Remote Patient lookup” application By using PHP, CSS, JavaScript, and AJAX which 
        can help medical staff to search the Patient’s medical history in various clinical management 
        software and display it on a webpage.
•	Developed Security to Authenticate user against Active Directory by using LDAP in PHP
•	Developed Web Services using SOAP to manipulate data from e-clinical works and other clinical 
        software.
•	Developing web-based Dashboard for E-clinical works application by using PHP (GD Library), 
        MySQL, CSS, HTML, AJAX which summarizes physician’s statistical data in graphical format, to be 
        used by hospital’s management staff.
•	Created various Bar Charts, Pie Charts, Gant Charts, and other formats of graphical charts by using 
        PHP Graphics.
•	Worked on a hotkey launch feature for a web application that fetches the patient’s name from e- 
        clinical works and open details of the medical history of that patient in the Remote Patient Lookup 
        application.
